item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt identifies a 21 September 2022 presidential address and states the cited reconciliation measures and support for Nairobi, Luanda, and the East African regional force. It does not establish implementation or outcomes."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt attributes these claims and requested actions to Tshisekedi's speech. It does not independently verify the allegations or implementation."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt states that Congolese law prohibits and severely sanctions the listed forms of hate speech and that the state and civil society would not permit them."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt reports hundreds of thousands fleeing abuses and clashes, specifies approximately 900,000 displaced by M23-FARDC clashes in North Kivu, and says humanitarian needs continued to increase."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt lists the cited MONUSCO operations and separately urges the government to reinforce deployments and pursue efforts addressing armed-group threats."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the Nairobi and Luanda processes, M23's partial withdrawal and continuing territorial control, the Luanda-communiqué violation, and severe escalation risk from DRC-Rwanda tensions."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt records transport of 126 tons of electoral material, MONUSCO engagement supporting inclusiveness, logistical and security obstacles, stakeholder distrust, and an opposition voter-registration boycott call."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The UN briefing reported that President Tshisekedi reshuffled his government on 24 March 2023, wished the new administration success in implementing its programme, and urged it to operationalize disarmament, demobilization and reintegration, security-sector reform, screening and vetting, and transitional-justice processes; it encouraged the government to remain firm in banning amnesty and army reintegration for persons responsible for serious human-rights violations.","notes":["The excerpt does not say the reshuffle was intended to support programme implementation; it only records the reshuffle and the speaker's wish for success."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt states that MONUSCO supported deployment of 174 police officers, enabling the successful February handover of Bendera camp, while noting that stronger Congolese security-force presence was needed to avoid protection gaps."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The index lists the 2023 mining-royalty decree, commercial-mining regulation, General Mining Inspectorate decree, and Superior Council of the Court of Auditors rules of procedure. It does not establish authorship, implementation, or effects."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt lists the 15 September 2023 interministerial order on the state's share of carbon-credit-sale profits and the 22 February 2023 decree establishing procedures for transactions involving public-enterprise mining assets."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E012","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Journal Officiel index lists a law dated 12 January 2023 modifying civil-aviation legislation, a law dated 28 December 2022 for the 2023 fiscal year, and a 3 March 2023 ministerial order appointing members of the permanent multisectoral commission coordinating medical and scientific cannabis activities.","notes":["The excerpt identifies the budget law as dated 28 December 2022 and concerning fiscal year 2023; it does not establish that it was enacted in 2023."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the 27 October 2023 publication date, the conclusion concerning current macroeconomic conditions, and the proposed diversification, mining, cassava, regional-trade, job, and poverty-reduction pathways."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt records 440 total alleged victims for August 2023 to April 2024, including 127 female children and 313 female internally displaced persons, in the listed provinces. It presents allegations, not adjudicated findings, and does not isolate the 2023 subset."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E015","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The government budget index listed downloadable 2023 expenditure and revenue PDF files with last-modified timestamps of 15 February 2023.","notes":["The excerpt shows filenames and timestamps but does not explicitly describe them as documents dated 15 February 2023 or provide budget contents."]}]}
